speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Welcome to your consultation. I need to understand your symptoms to help you. What is your age and what specific medical concerns brought you in today?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Tetanus. The history of no prenatal care and unavailable immunization records in a newborn is highly suspicious for this condition, often presenting with facial muscle spasms (sucking difficulty) or opisthotonos. I will observe for these specific signs to confirm.
